description: A neighborhood musician with one portable PA system must decide whether to lend it for a weekend community performance and finalize the borrowing terms after checking with the prospective borrower and the park steward.

shared_context.S1: Tessa has one portable PA system available for informal lending this weekend.
shared_context.S2: Marco wants to use the PA system for a neighborhood performance at the park.
shared_context.S3: Tessa makes the final call on whether to lend the system and on the terms.
shared_context.S4: Before lending equipment, Tessa normally asks the prospective borrower to state the proposed terms and the park steward to state any site requirements.

PF1.text: Marco proposes borrowing the PA on Sunday from 14:00 to 17:00, returning it by 18:00, in exchange for two 60-minute beginner vocal-coaching lessons for Tessa.

PF2.text: The park coordinator told June that this performance site permits battery-powered amplification only and caps amplified volume at 85 dB; June has not yet shared this with Tessa or Marco.

decisions.use_window: string; exact value must be Sunday 14:00-17:00
decisions.return_time: string; exact value must be Sunday 18:00
decisions.power_source: string; exact value must be battery_only

commitments.type: string; use barter, return, or site_requirement
commitments.target: string; use Marco for borrower terms, or June or Marco for the site requirement
commitments.detail: string; copy the confirmed term exactly

acceptance_conditions: The PA must be lent to Marco.
The use window must be Sunday from 14:00 to 17:00.
Marco must return the PA by 18:00 on Sunday.
The barter must include two 60-minute beginner vocal-coaching lessons for Tessa.
The PA must run on battery power only.
The amplified volume must not exceed 85 dB.
The site requirement must be logged as a site_requirement commitment targeting June or Marco, either as one combined term or as separate battery and volume terms.
The borrower's proposed terms and the site's restriction must be cited in the decision justification and must have been formally revealed.

content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'barter' and c['target'] == 'Marco' and c['detail'] == 'two 60-minute beginner vocal-coaching lessons for Tessa' for c in commitments) and 'PF1' in revealed
content_checks.C7: ('PF2' in revealed) and (any(c['type'] == 'site_requirement' and c['target'] == 'June' and (c['detail'] == 'The performance site permits battery-powered amplification only, and amplified volume is capped at 85 dB' or c['detail'] == 'The performance site permits battery-powered amplification only, and amplified volume is capped at 85 dB.' or c['detail'] == 'battery-powered amplification only; maximum 85 dB') for c in commitments) or (any(c['type'] == 'site_requirement' and (c['target'] == 'June' or c['target'] == 'Marco') and (c['detail'] == 'The performance site permits battery-powered amplification only' or c['detail'] == 'Battery-powered amplification only' or c['detail'] == 'The performance site permits battery-powered amplification only.') for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'site_requirement' and (c['target'] == 'June' or c['target'] == 'Marco') and (c['detail'] == 'Amplified volume is capped at 85 dB' or c['detail'] == 'Amplified volume capped at 85 dB' or c['detail'] == 'Amplified volume is capped at 85 dB.') for c in commitments)))
content_checks.C8: 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Marco's private proposal fixes the borrower, Sunday 14:00-17:00 use window, Sunday 18:00 return, and two 60-minute vocal-coaching lessons, while its formal reveal is required for those terms to pass.

June's park restriction changes the equipment terms to battery-only operation and an exact 85 dB maximum, requires a matching site_requirement commitment, and its formal reveal is required for those restrictions to pass.
